Open the UART terminal on the PC and hold Enter.
Press \"Reboot the TV\": the app reboots the TV through adb (the first time the TV asks whether to allow debugging: choose \"Always allow\"). Or unplug the TV and plug it in again.
Keep holding Enter until the MBOOT prompt appears, then type the commands:
First check.txt (checks only, writes nothing, ends with CHECK_OK), only then flash.txt.

If check.txt stopped at step 3 with \"Invalid FAT entry\", MBOOT cannot read the file from the drive: copy the RootMate files (images, *.CRC, *.txt) to a PC, format the drive as FAT32 and repeat. Do not delete files MBOOT wrote from the drive.
No access to files: grant \"All files access\".

The TV asks to allow debugging: press \"Allow\" (better \"Always allow\").
Cannot reach the TV\'s adb: turn on developer options and \"USB debugging\" (the Permissions screen). Opening the settings to reboot by hand.
adb did not answer. Opening the settings to reboot by hand.
Debugging was not allowed. Allow it on the TV or reboot the TV by hand in the settings.
Needed so the app can reboot the TV into MBOOT by itself and can be driven over adb. To turn on: \"About\" → press \"Build\" 7 times, then \"Developer options\" → \"USB debugging\".
adb does not listen on port 5555
Press \"Build\" 7 times until \"You are now a developer\", then come back to RootMate.
Turn on \"USB debugging\" (the \"Debugging\" section), then come back to RootMate.
Power LED of Tuvio TO48/55/65UFGCV5 TVs, without changing the boot image. Needs root (Magisk).
No root access: allow RootMate in Magisk
A different module build is installed (%1$s)
Remove the module? The LED goes back to the stock behaviour.
In standby the LED blinks at full brightness: while the CPU sleeps the PWM blinks on its own, and it cannot be dim and blink at the same time.
\"Off\" is the firmware\'s own state. After the screen turns on, the firmware shows its own LED state for a fraction of a second, then the module restores the chosen one.
